function.name: get_volume_corners
function.description: Read-only: get four rotated ground corners (Y=0), stable corner IDs and near/far/left/right labels from captured viewer. Side ties select farther corner. Never edits notes.

function.name: point_inside_volume
function.description: Read-only: calculate a ground point inward from a volume corner. toward_center = diagonal distance toward center; from_walls = distance from each adjoining wall. Use returned position with move_note; never create a replacement note.

function.name: offset_point
function.description: Read-only: offset a point by meters in viewer/scene axes or toward/away from captured camera. ground=true projects direction horizontally and places result at Y=0. Toward-viewer stops at viewer, never passes it. Use result with move_note.
